title: Space Pinball Neon
description: Launch glowing energy spheres into a neon cosmic pinball table—smash glowing bumpers, trigger multiplier ramps, and keep the ball alive with crisp flippers.
controls: Pull to launch the ball and tap left/right screen sides to fire the neon pinball flippers.

zh-CN.title: 霓虹太空弹球
zh-CN.description: 炫酷霓虹街机太空弹球：弹射能量光球撞击星际保险杠与加分轨道，左右拨板极限救球刷爆高分榜！
zh-CN.controls: 拉动发射弹球，点击屏幕左/右侧操控拨板将弹球击回高分区刷爆连击。
